title: Formspec App Manifest
description: A Formspec App Manifest per the App Manifest specification (formerly Bundle Manifest; reframed per ADR 0150 §5.2/§5.3/§11.2). The author-facing composition envelope above a Formspec app. An app composes zero-or-more Definitions, zero-or-more Surfaces, zero-or-more Registries, and OPTIONAL substrate Modules / Sessions / Locales / Mappings / Theme / Component / References / Ontology / Experience / Response Actions. App Manifest v2.1 adds optional dataSources[] sibling references; v2.0 manifests remain valid but MUST NOT carry dataSources[]. `definitions` is REQUIRED but MAY be an empty array (non-form apps — workflow viewers, registry browsers, etc. — compose surfaces without Definitions). The `$formspecBundle` const originally bumped to '2.0' so strict-validating consumers of the legacy '1.0' shape fail loud rather than silently mis-parse a structurally different document. See specs/bundle/app-manifest-spec.md for normative prose.
$comment: Bundle-graph id-uniqueness invariant per ADR 0150 §5.3: every authored ComponentBase.id reachable from this App Manifest MUST be unique across all referenced Component documents (not merely per-document). JSON Schema cannot enforce cross-document uniqueness; linter rule E605 (COMP-BUNDLE-ID-COLLISION) walks the bundle graph and hard-fails on duplicates. Load-bearing for cross-document Component-tree refactors (ADR 0151).

$formspecBundle.description: App Manifest specification version. MUST be '2.0' or '2.1'. The v2.0 bump from '1.0' per ADR 0150 §5.2/§11.2 is structural; v2.1 is the first additive minor and introduces dataSources[] sibling references. Documents with dataSources[] MUST use '2.1'.

x-lm.intent: Version pin for App Manifest document compatibility

version.description: Version of this App Manifest. MUST be a strict SemVer 2.0.0 string (no leading zeros in numeric identifiers, no empty pre-release identifiers, no leading-zero numeric pre-release identifiers). The app's published version pins a coherent snapshot of sibling versions; bumping any sibling version SHOULD bump the app version.

id.description: Stable canonical identity URL for this app. Distinct from any sibling URL. Two App Manifests with the same `id` SHOULD be different versions of the same app.
id.$comment: Cross-property distinctness (id != any sibling url) is a semantic invariant the schema cannot express; processors enforce it per app-manifest-spec §2.1 / §6.1 rule 3.

definitions.description: REQUIRED. Zero-or-more Definitions this app composes. An empty array (`[]`) is valid and identifies a non-form app (e.g. workflow viewer, registry browser) that composes surfaces or modules without Definitions. A single-element array is the form-only common case. Multiple Definitions support multi-form apps (e.g. an intake suite composing several screening forms). Per ADR 0150 §5.2/§5.3.

x-lm.intent: Composed Definition artifacts (plural; MAY be empty)

experience.description: Optional Experience document reference (task intent). When absent, the form has no authored task intent layer; Trace simply lacks Experience edges. No synthesis.

responseActions.description: Optional Response Actions document reference (form-scoped action orchestration). When absent, the form has no named actions; submit happens via host UI.

component.description: Optional Component document reference (concrete UI tree). When absent, the renderer falls back to Definition's existing widget defaults.

theme.description: Optional Theme document reference (visual tokens, density, presentation defaults). When absent, the renderer uses its built-in defaults.

references.description: Optional References document (external resource attachments: policy, documentation, examples, tools).

ontology.description: Optional Ontology document (concept metadata for items and choices).

registries.description: Optional list of Registry documents (option-set / module / token registry enrichment). Plural per ADR 0150 §5.2 — an app MAY compose multiple registries (e.g. a tenant-local registry overlaid on a stack-shared registry).

surfaces.description: Optional list of Surface documents (presentation/layout shells; the Surface spec lands at ADR 0150 §14 P2). Plural so an app MAY compose multiple surfaces (e.g. a respondent surface and a reviewer surface).

dataSources.description: Optional list of Data Sources catalog documents. This member is valid only when `$formspecBundle` is '2.1'. Entries use URL/version sibling identity; they MUST NOT use local fixture paths or implicit discovery.

modules.description: Optional declaration of substrate modules this app depends on. Each entry is a canonical ModuleRef (id + version, with optional publisher + lockHash for posture admission). Default-module-set behavior per ADR 0150 §4.9 preserves form-only apps — omitting modules[] is identical to declaring the core module set. Per ADR 0150 §5.2 the App Manifest is the canonical declaration site; document-level `modules[]` on individual sibling documents remain valid scoping declarations. Coherence rule (§5.2): every module declared by a sibling document MUST resolve against the App Manifest's modules[] declaration or the default module set.

sessions.description: Optional list of Sessions held against the app. Each entry is a canonical SessionRef (id + openedAt + actors). The durable session index — respondent-ledger.sessionRefs[] entries reference these URNs (ADR 0150 §5.5).

locales.description: Optional array of Locale references, one per BCP47 locale tag. Each entry's `locale` MUST be unique within the array.

mappings.description: Optional array of Mapping references, one per named mapping handle. Each entry's `handle` MUST be unique within the array.

Slug.description: Shared slug pattern: ASCII letter start, then letters / digits / `_` / `-`. Used by `bundle.name` and `MappingRef.handle` so the two surfaces evolve in lockstep.

url.description: Canonical URL of the referenced sibling artifact.

version.description: Optional SemVer string (exact: '1.2.0') or range expression ('>=1.0.0 <2.0.0', '^1.0.0'). When omitted, any compatible-by-major version is accepted. Producers SHOULD pin exact versions in published bundles.

locale.description: BCP47 locale tag. Pattern aligned with the Locale spec's own tag pattern (schemas/locale.schema.json `locale`); canonical BCP47 conformance remains the Locale spec's responsibility.

handle.description: Author-chosen handle. Response Actions and other consumers resolve `mappingRef` by this handle.
